## What changes?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Verification

List the commands and browser checks you actually ran, with results. Explain anything not run.

## Screenshots or evidence

For visible changes, include before/after screenshots. For classification, ingestion, or Ask, include a real example and a negative case. Remove secrets and private data.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and the description explains its purpose.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; additional storage/browser checks are recorded above when needed.
- [ ] Documentation and environment-variable examples are updated where needed.
- [ ] Schema changes describe migration order and rollout requirements, if applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, production data, or material I lack permission to contribute are included.
